positive_intent: Resolve conditional finite-matrix native-vertex and embedding identities with exact, mutation-sensitive blocks and an independent generalized-eigenproblem finite-difference oracle.

definitions.coordinate: One real differentiable coordinate R, reference R=0; each coordinate a is treated separately.
definitions.generalized_model: S(R) positive definite Hermitian, H(R) Hermitian, complete S-normalized eigenvectors C at reference, H C = S C E, Cdagger S C=I, real diagonal E.
definitions.native: D_ji = c_j^dagger (Hprime - epsilon_i Sprime) c_i; row j final, column i initial. This is a coordinate-matrix definition, not assumed to be a physical force.
definitions.embedding: Explicit differentiable full-column-rank T into a fixed finite Hilbert frame, S=Tdagger T, H=Tdagger h T with h Hermitian. Square invertible and rectangular embeddings are distinguished.
definitions.units: Abstract dimensionless finite-matrix units, no material calibration.

questions: What generalized-eigenproblem, normalization and Hermiticity identities follow without an embedding?
How do energy shifts, complex conjugation, phase/degenerate gauges and coordinate-dependent coefficient frames transform the native object?
Which embedding and connection data suffice to recover projected hprime, and what exact ambiguities survive with the same H,S and derivatives?
Does a rectangular embedding add residual data not supplied by the generalized eigenproblem?
block_tree: blocks/exact.py: exact residual and exposing-mutation primitives
blocks/native.py: reference normalization, generalized derivative, adjoint and Hermitian-part identities
blocks/transformations.py: energy-origin, complex gauges, nonunit normalizations and moving coefficient frames
blocks/embedding.py: product-rule embedding, connection, nonuniqueness and rectangular residual counterexample
blocks/numerical.py: independent scipy.linalg.eigh and centered finite differences with refinement
runner.py: block composition and durable source-bound complete/failed receipts
derivation.txt: report only checked identities, hypotheses, counterexamples and applicability

verification.exact: SymPy exact rational asymmetric complex noncommuting examples, generic component identities where feasible, product-rule differentiation from declared curves. Every load-bearing check has a meaningful mutation or named counterexample.
verification.independent_numeric: SciPy generalized Hermitian eigensolve on independently evaluated smooth H(R),S(R), phase-align eigenvectors to the reference, centered differences at h=0.04,0.02,0.01,0.005. Compare derivative eigenvalues, eigenvector connection, normalization and laboratory hprime. Separate exact identities from float evidence.
verification.numeric_acceptance: Finite full-rank reference, eigenvalue gaps >0.1, S minimum eigenvalue >0.1; centered-difference errors decrease with empirical order between 1.7 and 2.3 over final two refinements; final max errors <0.002. Wrong-energy/omitted-overlap/connection mutations must remain separated by >0.01 at reference. If floors intervene preserve failure before any prospective change.

source_boundary.independence: No ForceSourceAudit output consumed. Literature is not used to license the finite construction as a physical Ni vertex.

pass_licenses: Conditional algebraic reconstruction only under explicitly checked finite-dimensional assumptions; exact counterexamples settle stated insufficiency claims.
maximum_verdict: symbolic_verified conditional finite identities plus numeric_evidence on declared curves
failure_scope: A failed block stops canonical composition and is preserved before repair; no physical inference from algebraic success.
unlocks: Root integration after independent source and metric slices settle; no W2 production license.
